baseline_models.focus_anchor: The preposition at word 1 governs the coordinated plural nouns at words 2 and 3, presenting gardens and springs as one inhabited setting.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tree cover and flowing sources form a coupled ecology: dense growth encloses the inhabitant while water continually renews the enclosure.

activation_trace.role: A tree-covered orchard supplies the enclosing vegetative half of the setting.
A flowing water source supplies the renewing current that makes the enclosure living rather than static.

changed_reading.before: Two adjacent amenities: gardens and springs.
changed_reading.after: A single self-renewing habitat whose vegetation shelters because water rises within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتٍ at word 2 and عُيُونٍ at word 3 coordinate a root of concealment with a root of seeing and manifest presence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated nouns hold cover and visibility together. The enclosure can grant privacy without erasing encounter, so hiddenness becomes a condition of unthreatened presence rather than absence.

activation_trace.role: Covering from perception supplies protected interiority to the gardens.
Face-to-face seeing supplies direct presence inside, rather than outside, the covered space.

changed_reading.after: A protected interior where concealment and direct presence coexist.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots at words 2 and 3 each carry a protection-related branch alongside their ordinary garden and spring senses.
baseline_models.mechanism: A shielding cover and an attentive eye converge on a sanctuary model. This is a branch overlay, not a replacement of the lexical garden-and-springs reading.

activation_trace.role: The protective-cover branch makes the garden enclosure function as a shield.
The watchful-care branch makes the surrounding eyes or sources an image of attentive protection.

changed_reading.after: A nested safety system: enclosing protection joined to continuous attentive care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The womb branch of mercy meets the focus root's hidden-fetus branch and its flowing-water branch. Together they activate a life-bearing enclosure in which hidden life is sustained rather than merely screened.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in a womb supplies a contained-life image for the garden enclosure.
The flowing source supplies the life-supporting fluid in the gestational analogy.
The womb branch gives the earlier mercy a concrete containing and life-bearing form.

structural_cues: 44:6 names mercy, while 44:52 locates its beneficiaries inside plural enclosures and sources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, hidden fetus, and flowing source; I supply the analogy that transfers their material relation to the garden setting. The live alternative is mercy as benevolence with no gestational coloring.

changed_reading.before: Mercy precedes a later garden reward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy takes spatial form as a water-sustained enclosure that carries protected life into a new condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The smoke sequence makes covering ethically unstable: one cover rises from fuel, envelops people, and must be lifted; the focus later supplies vegetative cover that shields and a source that flows. The change is from harmful envelopment to habitable shelter.

activation_trace.role: The shielding-cover branch supplies the beneficial pole of enclosure.
The emerging-water branch supplies a life-giving fluid counterpart to smoke.
Smoke rising from combustion supplies an airborne material that can occupy and spoil a whole environment.
An all-enveloping cover makes the smoke sequence a hostile counterpart to garden enclosure.
Lifting a cover supplies the release operation that separates afflicting cover from protective cover.

structural_cues: 44:10 introduces smoke, 44:11 says it envelops people, and 44:12 asks that the affliction be uncovered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of cover and an uncovering operation; I infer a reversal from toxic enclosure to sheltering enclosure. The live alternative is that the smoke and garden images remain only sequential contrasts.

changed_reading.before: The gardens simply conceal and the springs simply flow.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a corrected environment: cover no longer suffocates, and fluid now issues as a sustaining source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first bears the accusation of a mind veiled by madness and later names tree-veiled gardens. The later occurrence can therefore reclassify hiddenness from alleged cognitive failure into protective habitation, while the coordinated eye/source root keeps perception live.

activation_trace.role: Mental veiling supplies the hostile accusatory use of the shared concealment root.
Tree-veiled gardens turn the same root's hiddenness into habitable abundance.
Direct seeing keeps the transformed hiddenness from being mistaken for loss of perception.

structural_cues: 44:14 applies the root in a dismissive predicate; 44:52 returns it as the plural destination noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition and sharply different branches; I supply the rehabilitative arrow from slur to shelter. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no retrospective correction.

changed_reading.before: جَنَّاتٍ is only the expected garden noun.
changed_reading.after: The garden root also answers an earlier misuse of hiddenness: what was called obscured reason is recast as lucid, protected dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact garden-and-springs pairing first belongs to what a defeated people leave, then reappears as where the protected dwell. Abandonment, inheritance, and deliverance convert the focus from generic scenery into a reversal of occupancy: abundance is neither permanent property nor morally inert.

activation_trace.role: Relinquishing a thing supplies the vacancy that makes the first gardens and springs transferable.
The earlier tree-covered gardens establish the exact material echo with the focus.
The earlier flowing springs complete the repeated pair rather than offering a loose thematic resemblance.
Transfer from a predecessor to a successor supplies the change-of-occupancy mechanism.
Deliverance by separation supplies the route by which a rescued community leaves affliction behind.
The focus gardens receive the earlier estate image under a new mode of occupancy.
The focus springs seal the exact pairing and preserve its water-bearing continuity across the reversal.

structural_cues: 44:24-30 moves from an opened sea and drowning through abandoned gardens and springs to inheritance and rescue.
44:25 and 44:52 repeat the same two rooted nouns in the same order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition, abandonment, transfer, and deliverance; I infer that the later occupancy reverses the earlier one. The live alternative is contrast between two garden sets without an implied transfer relation.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and springs denote a timeless reward landscape.
changed_reading.after: They also bear the memory of evacuated power: the same abundance that could be left behind becomes secure habitation for different occupants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden root's burial-cover and fresh-beginning branches meet explicit resurrection and the later exclusion of renewed death. Flowing springs let the covered place read not as a terminal grave but as an enclosure unfolded into continuing life.

activation_trace.role: Burial and shrouding supply the terminal form of concealment that the model reverses.
Fresh beginning supplies a second, nonterminal trajectory within the same focus root.
Flowing springs give the new-beginning trajectory an ongoing material source.
Reviving the dead supplies the explicit opening from death into renewed life.
Loss of life, grammatically excluded after the first death, marks what cannot recur inside the focus setting.
Deflection of harm supplies the barrier that keeps the regenerated enclosure from reverting to death.

structural_cues: 44:35 voices denial of being raised, while 44:56 denies any death beyond the first and names protection from the blaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burial, fresh beginning, resurrection, death, and protection; I infer a directional reversal from grave-cover to living enclosure. The live alternative is the simpler sequence of resurrection followed by reward without root-level transformation.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants enter a garden after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The focus garden becomes the transformed logic of covering itself: no longer shroud or terminus, but a watered beginning protected from another death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human aid is negated, mercy is excepted, and the protected are then placed in a secure station before the focus phrase. This converts the baseline shield-and-watch overlay into an operational safety architecture grounded in mercy rather than ordinary patronage.

activation_trace.role: Aid and vindicating support, explicitly negated in the ayah, remove ordinary rescue as the safety mechanism.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated exception to the failure of human support.
Putting oneself within protection identifies the occupants by their relation to guardedness.
Settled confidence and safety give the immediately preceding station its affective condition.
The shielding cover turns the garden into the spatial implementation of protection.
The eye of care turns the springs or eyes into the attentive implementation of security.

structural_cues: 44:41-42 moves from failed patronal aid to mercy as exception.
44:51 immediately introduces a secure station and 44:52 specifies its interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed aid, mercy, guarded identity, security, shield, and watchful care; I infer that the latter pair implements the former sequence spatially. The live alternative is that security merely labels the setting without specifying its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Shield and watchcare are optional root resonances.
changed_reading.after: They become a coherent account of how the secure station works: enclosing harm-deflection joined to attentive care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment sequence also combines tree and fluid, but its tree feeds harm and its fluid boils, invades the belly, and is poured from above. The focus repairs the same material system: tree growth becomes inhabitable cover and fluid becomes an emerging spring.

activation_trace.role: The stemmed tree supplies the vegetative component on the punitive side of the contrast.
Boiling and overflowing supply destructive motion to the punitive fluid.
Hot water supplies the thermal quality opposed by the focus's habitable springs.
Pouring from above supplies forced one-way fluid movement, unlike water emerging as a source.
Tree-covered gardens convert harmful vegetation into an inhabitable canopy.
Flowing sources convert invasive heated fluid into renewing water.

structural_cues: 44:43-48 binds a tree, ingestion, boiling, interior invasion, and downward pouring before 44:52 recombines vegetation and water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel tree-fluid materials with opposed qualities; I infer a functional reversal from invasion to habitation. The live alternative is a broad reward-punishment contrast without a shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and springs are positive scenery after a negative scene.
changed_reading.after: They are the positive reconfiguration of the same material channels: vegetation shelters instead of feeds pain, and water rises to sustain instead of descending to burn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah layers clothing-cover inside garden-cover and places the clothed occupants face to face. This sharpens concealment-with-presence into a social design: nested privacy supports reciprocal visibility rather than isolation.

activation_trace.role: Environmental covering supplies the outer protected layer.
Direct seeing supplies manifest interpersonal presence within the cover.
Covering by clothing supplies an inner personal layer nested inside the garden enclosure.
One thing facing another supplies reciprocal orientation among the covered occupants.

structural_cues: 44:53 follows immediately and combines clothing with the plural reciprocal form 'facing one another.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two covers and face-to-face orientation; I infer spatial nesting and a privacy-enables-encounter relation. The live alternative is a list of independent luxuries with no social architecture.

changed_reading.before: The enclosure permits presence in an abstract sense.
changed_reading.after: The enclosure organizes social life: personal and environmental cover coexist with unobstructed mutual regard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate recurrence of ع ي ن in an ocular construction reactivates the eye branches beside the focus's spring branch. Pairing and eye contrast add a social and visual layer to the waterscape without disambiguating the focus noun away from springs.

activation_trace.role: The flowing-source branch keeps the focus noun materially aqueous.
The seeing-eye branch remains latent in the same focus root and becomes available to the immediate echo.
Joining one counterpart to another supplies the relational frame for the ocular activation.
Marked eye contrast supplies the explicit ocular environment around the repeated root.
Wide beautiful eyes make the immediate recurrence decisively visual.

structural_cues: 44:54 follows after one intervening ayah and repeats the ع ي ن root in an explicitly ocular phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate root recurrence, pairing, and ocular branches; I infer backward activation of an eye-layer in the focus. The live alternative is homonymic echo with no change to the spring reading.

changed_reading.before: عُيُونٍ contributes only flowing springs to the habitat.
changed_reading.after: The springs remain water sources while also becoming landscape 'eyes' within a scene organized by pairing and mutual sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling for every fruit while secure makes the garden-source ecology responsive rather than decorative. The enclosure continually yields accessible provision, and security removes the scarcity behavior of guarding or competing for it.

activation_trace.role: Vigorous, abundant plant growth supplies a productive rather than merely scenic garden.
Continuously flowing sources supply the productive system's renewable input.
Calling by speech supplies demand that receives an immediate place within the habitat.
Comprehensive totality expands provision from selected produce to every kind requested.
Pleasant fruit supplies the consumable output of the garden's growth.
Settled safety makes unrestricted access noncompetitive and unafraid.

structural_cues: 44:55 keeps the occupants inside the same setting and joins calling, every fruit, and security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant growth, renewable water, calling, totality, fruit, and security; I infer a responsive provisioning system. The live alternative is that the ayah only lists permission to request existing fruit.

changed_reading.before: The gardens and springs are available surroundings.
changed_reading.after: They function as a secure, renewable provisioning ecology whose abundance is available on demand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses from tears to springs and is therefore surprising; it remains anchored in the focus root's simultaneous water-source and seeing-eye branches plus 44:29's explicit weeping. Render it only as a fluid-ocular inter-ayah resonance, not as a claim that عُيُونٍ lexically means tears here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عُيُونٍ at word 3 carries both flowing-water and seeing-eye branches, allowing the earlier absence of weeping to perturb the later water image.

activation_trace.role: Grief expressed through tears and sound supplies the fluid explicitly withheld from the former occupants.
The bodily eye supplies the organ from which tears would issue.
The flowing source converts the shared fluid register into sustained life rather than mourning.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, life-giving flow appears where cosmic tears for the dispossessed were absent: water is reassigned from mourning to habitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move from mutual waiting to eyes of care is affective rather than lexical and may overconnect the surah's closing command; it remains anchored in the focus eye's scout and watchcare branches and the repeated watch root at 44:59. Render it as a surveillance reversal, not as the primary sense of springs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ع ي ن root at word 3 can designate either a sent observing eye or an eye of protective attention while retaining its spring sense.

activation_trace.role: The scout or sentinel eye supplies the potentially hostile surveillance pole.
The eye of watchful care supplies the non-hostile protective pole.
Mutual watching and waiting keep adversarial observation active at the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: Watchfulness is simply another possible protection overlay.
changed_reading.after: The focus tentatively marks an exchange of regimes: hostile mutual watching remains outside, while attentive observation inside has become care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The economic branch of ع ي ن and the perilous-desert branch of ف و ز are form-distant from the immediate surface senses; the reading remains anchored through the focus's exact-item root and 44:57's surplus, gift, and success cluster. Render it as a resonance of tangible non-deferred possession after danger, never as a lexical translation of عُيُونٍ as cash.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عُيُونٍ at word 3 retains a branch of present tangible wealth, while the coordinated gardens give that tangibility a concrete inhabited form.

activation_trace.role: The concrete orchard supplies an inhabitable asset rather than an abstract promise.
Present tangible wealth, opposed to absent debt, supplies the non-deferred quality of the reward.
Surplus and remainder make the habitat exceed bare rescue or sufficiency.
Gift and benefaction prevent the tangible surplus from reading as earned ownership alone.
A passage poised between survival and destruction supplies the danger crossed before tangible surplus is present.

changed_reading.before: The reward is future abundance described pictorially.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is present and non-deferred surplus after a perilous crossing, concretely inhabited yet received as gift.

strongest_changes: The exact 44:25 repetition turns scenery into a reversal of occupancy: abundance abandoned under judgment becomes secure habitation after deliverance.
Smoke and boiling-water sequences polarize cover and fluid, so the focus repairs harmful envelopment into shelter and invasive liquid into sustaining source.
The 44:51-55 sequence makes the setting operationally secure, socially reciprocal, visually doubled, and responsively abundant.
Burial and fresh-beginning branches let the garden carry a contained transition from death into protected continuing life.
summary.what_was_special: A two-root focus supported several coexisting mechanisms: enclosure and source, concealment and presence, transferred estate, material reversal, protective watchcare, and the immediate eye-spring doubling. Context repeatedly changed the function of the same images without requiring lexical disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: The gestational mercy model is materially coherent but depends on branch-distant womb and fetus activations.
The exact 44:25 echo securely creates contrast, but whether it implies a stronger transfer relation than typological reversal remains open.
The eye layer activated by 44:54 should coexist with, not replace, the ordinary spring reading.
The tears, surveillance, and tangible-surplus outliers are traceable resonances whose directional arrows remain speculative.
